Experience Lofoten in luxury! Our brand-new lodge in beautiful Lyngvær, completed in January 2025, offers comfort and modern amenities for up to 10 guests. Enjoy breathtaking views through large panoramic windows, a relaxing jacuzzi, and a sauna after a day of adventure. The fully equipped kitchen and spacious living areas ensure a perfect stay. Watch the Northern Lights dance across the sky from the comfort of your lodge. Ideal for families and friends. Welcome!

The space
Welcome to our exclusive lodge in the heart of Lofoten! This newly built holiday home from 2025 combines modern comfort with the tranquility of nature and spectacular surroundings. 
With a spacious of 98 kvm, this is the perfect destination for families and groups of friends seeking an unforgettable experience in the north.

The lodge has four comfortable bedrooms and a total of 10 sleeping places, including two bedrooms with double beds (180 cm), one bedroom with a family bed (150/90 cm), and one bedroom with a family bed (120/90 cm). 

The large terrace, partially covered, features a jacuzzi, outdoor grill, fire barrel, and outdoor furniture for cozy evenings outside. 

The lodge is equipped with modern amenities such as WiFi, TV, washing machine, dryer, hairdryer, curling iron, and iron. 
The fully equipped kitchen includes a dishwasher, wine cabinet, kettle, toaster, and coffee maker. 
For warmth and atmosphere, there is waterborne underfloor heating with a heat pump and a cozy wood stove/fireplace for chilly evenings. 

The property also offers two bathrooms, an electric vehicle charger, and easy check-in via door code.

The lodge is situated in scenic surroundings in Lyngvær, surrounded by majestic mountains and fjords. Here, you have access to spectacular hiking opportunities, fishing, and the unique tranquility that Lofoten offers. It is only 10 minutes from Henningsvær and 20 minutes from Svolvær.

Self-check-in is available via a door code, and pets are not allowed. Air conditioning is not available. 

Experience the ultimate combination of luxury and nature at our Nordic Lodge Retreat in Lofoten. 
We look forward to welcoming you!

We had a wonderful stay at Lofoten Lodge. The property was easy to find, and communication with the hosts before arrival was excellent.
The lodge was exceptionally clean, comfortable and very well equipped. The beds were incredibly comfortable, and we honestly slept so well during our stay! We also made great use of the sauna most evenings and enjoyed the hot tub a few times when the weather was fair.
The hosts were fantastic. Whenever we had a question or a minor issue, they responded within around 20 minutes, and there were caretakers nearby who could help with anything that needed attention, which gave us great peace of mind.
The location is absolutely beautiful, surrounded by mountains and overlooking the fjord. We were lucky enough to enjoy some stunning sunsets from the lodge, which made the stay even more special.
It’s also a really convenient base for exploring Lofoten, being close to Henningsvær and Svolvær, as well as attractions such as the Lofoten Aquarium.

Unfortunately, the view was the biggest disappointment of our stay. The photos no longer fully correspond to the current situation, as the view is now partially blocked by new buildings. As a result, the accommodation looks a bit different on site than shown in the pictures. We had chosen the house mainly because of the views.
Other than that, we had a very pleasant stay. The accommodation is spacious and great for larger groups. Particularly noteworthy are the beautiful lounge area and the well-equipped kitchen, which offer plenty of space for cooking and spending time together. The place was clean and functionally furnished, so we felt very comfortable overall. 
Despite the limited view, we can recommend the accommodation for groups. However, updating the pictures would help to better match the expectations of future guests with reality.
